description: 16-position DIP IC socket, 2.54 mm pitch, 7.62 mm (0.3 in) row spacing, tin contacts, through hole, for a PT2399 in Package_DIP:DIP-16_W7.62mm

evidence.note: Mouser Search API, 2026-11-13: exact match for 2485264-3 (TE Connectivity), Mouser part 571-2485264-3, 'IC & Component Sockets DIP IC SOCKET 16P,Sn'. Digi-Key Product Information API, 2026-11-13: 17-2485264-3-ND, 'DIP IC SOCKET 16P,SN', TE Connectivity AMP Connectors.
Digi-Key Product Information API, 2026-11-13: 'Number of Positions or Pins (Grid): 16'; Mouser description 'DIP IC SOCKET 16P'.
Digi-Key Product Information API, 2026-11-13: 'Type: DIP, 0.3" (7.62mm) Row Spacing'; 'Mounting Type: Through Hole'.

why: A plain open-frame stamped DIP-16 socket in tin, 0.3 in row spacing, at the lowest price seen for a 16-position socket in ones ($2.16 Mouser, $2.27 Digi-Key; the Samtec ICO-316-STT is $1.76 but at Digi-Key is 0 stock and the Mill-Max 110-93-316-41-001000 and Samtec ICA/ICO machined types cost more). Owner ruled 2026-11-13 to fit a DIP-16 socket for the PT2399. No datasheet was read: the pins, pitch and row spacing are the supplier's own stated parameters (Digi-Key), and TE's datasheet was not fetched. A socket shares the IC's land pattern, so the board's footprint is unchanged.
